methodology:
Williamson Tea Kenya operates mature tea estates in Kenya's prime tea-growing regions (Nandi Hills, Tinderet area) plus some timber land. 2024 revenue KSh 4.2B with profit KSh 527M.

Land values translated: 2024 KTDA broker comps for mature Kenyan tea estate land at ~$7,500 USD/acre × KES 130/USD = ~KSh 975,000/acre. Williamson's book value reflects decades-old colonial-era cost basis, materially below current market.

Yahoo coverage of Nairobi tickers is spotty — the live-price portion of the comp may not resolve cleanly.
